caption: The drawing depicts an object centered on a plain, off-white or beige background. The object appears to be a combination of a revolver, brass knuckles, and a knife. The revolver section has a dark metallic color and is positioned at the left, with a visible cylinder and trigger. Attached directly beneath the revolver is a set of four interconnected brass knuckle loops, also dark in color, with a textured grip handle. Extending to the right from the knuckle grip is a straight-edged knife blade, similarly metallic in appearance. The drawing is minimalist in style, with the only text visible being the name "WAYNE WHITE" printed in small, simple letters below and to the right of the object. The rest of the background is blank and unadorned.
title: Apache Gun
